text:
liz: Quick sync—final scope freeze in ~24h. We need owners for these four buckets: SLA wording, docs & quickstart, oncall/runbook, monitoring + alerts. Callouts only, please.

aj: I can own SLA wording and SLI targets. Will put up a short PR tonight with p50/p95 and measurement windows.

maria: Docs + quickstart for me. Can someone confirm the final flag list and example curl? @aj I'll need the SLO numbers to wire in examples.

aj: Draft SLOs: availability 99.5% (monthly), latency p50 200ms, p95 800ms for hosted. For Dedicated well keep p50/p95 but widen p95 to 1.2s in the contract note. PR: https://git.redwood/slo/PR-456

devin: Ill take oncall/runbook. Plan: paging flow, escalation matrix, circuit-breaker + graceful fallback (route to smaller model variant or cached response). Ill add a short incident comms template.

sam: Monitoring and alerts here. Ill add dashboard panels for latency_by_model, cost_per_token, kv_cache_hit_rate, batching_ratio, and model_variant_fallbacks. Need final SLOs and any new metric names.

liz: For docs public vs internal: publish a short quantization recommendation guide publicly, keep the deep perf tradeoffs internal. Maria, include a link to the internal deep-dive.

marco: Legal check: Dedicated/Private raises data residency and KMS obligations. One contract line needs precise language  will post suggested wording by morning.

opsbot: deploy-bot: prod-freeze starts in ~22h unless blockers posted. https://deploys/redwood/1234

maria: Question: do we publish the exact p95 numbers in public docs or only in SLA? Some customers will reference public docs for expectations.

liz: Publish the SLOs in the public "service expectations" page and keep contractual SLAs in the contract annex. Call out that contract overrides the public page.

aj: Added measurement window and alert hints in PR. Ill include rationale for why p50/p95 chosen and what counts as availability.

devin: Runbook snippet draft:
- who to page: oncall -> eng-sre -> product
- fallback: route to compatible smaller model variant or cached summary
- rollback: automated config toggle + manual rollback steps
- customer comms: template + 1-hour initial ack, 24-hour follow-up

sam: Ill wire alert thresholds after aj confirms SLOs. Also propose an alert for kv_cache_hit_rate < 60% sustained for 5m.

liz: OK owners captured. Ill consolidate into a one-page checklist in Confluence and ping execs after legal signs off. If you have any safety-net asks (extra capacity, warm standby, manual failover runbook) drop them in #release-war-room now.

aj: ack :thumbsup:

maria: ack

marco: ack, will update with precise contract wording here tomorrow AM.

opsbot: reminder: last-minute safety-net requests go in #release-war-room.
